headline: Death Toll Disputed After Central African Republic Gold Mine Collapse
desc: At least 107 people are reported dead after an artisanal gold mine collapsed in the Central African Republic, with rescue efforts ongoing.

headline: DRC Ebola Outbreak Passes 3,000 Deaths as WHO Warns Transmission Still Accelerating
desc: The DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths, with WHO warning most deaths are now occurring in communities rather than treatment centres.

headline: Zambia's Mundubile Formally Charged With Treason as Hichilema Sworn In
desc: Opposition leader Brian Mundubile has been formally charged with treason alongside 17 others as President Hichilema begins his second term.

headline: Google Changes European Search Policy After EU Pressure
desc: Google is changing how it applies part of its search spam policy across the European Economic Area after regulators raised concerns about the system's impact on publishers.

headline: Norway Enters New Royal Era After Death of King Harald
desc: Norway has entered a new chapter after the death of King Harald V, ending a reign that lasted more than three decades. Crown Prince Haakon is now King.

headline: Russia Warns Britain Over Ukraine Missile Support
desc: Russia has warned that British military facilities could become targets if Ukraine continues using British-supplied long-range missiles against Russian territory.

headline: Ukraine Under Heavy Russian Air Assault as Air-Defence Pressure Grows
desc: Ukraine has endured another major Russian air assault involving a large number of drones and missiles, as Kyiv's air-defence network faces mounting strain.

headline: Ukraine Signals September Window for Renewed Peace Talks
desc: Ukraine believes another round of talks involving Russia and the United States could become possible in September, though no peace summit has been confirmed.

headline: Nigel Farage Re-Elected MP for Clacton in UK By-Election
desc: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has been re-elected as Member of Parliament for Clacton following a by-election.

headline: Six Months In, Strait of Hormuz Disruption Still Reshaping Global Shipping
desc: A prolonged disruption to traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has kept one of the world's busiest shipping corridors running at a fraction of normal capacity.

headline: Meta Faces Trial as $18 Billion Child-Safety Settlement Emerges
desc: Meta has agreed to a settlement worth up to $18 billion over claims Facebook and Instagram were designed to keep minors engaged, alongside an ongoing California trial.

headline: Nepal Flood Disaster: Death Toll Passes 1,375 as Rescuers Free Survivors From Hydropower Tunnels
desc: Nepal and Tibet's flood death toll has risen to 1,375 with over 5,000 still missing, even as rescuers pull survivors alive from a hydropower tunnel nine days on.

headline: Taiwan Fortifies Penghu as Military Prepares for the Possibility of a Chinese Attack
desc: Taiwan is strengthening military and civilian preparations around the Penghu Islands as planners assess how the strategically important island group could be defended.

headline: UN Awaits $725 Million U.S. Payment as Financial Pressure Deepens
desc: The US has notified Congress of an $850 million planned UN payment ($725m regular budget, $125m peacekeeping) — still not confirmed as received by the world body.

headline: US-Canada Trade Talks Collapse, 50% Tariffs Now in Effect
desc: Trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed just before a midnight deadline, triggering 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods.

headline: Nigeria's AI Misinformation Problem Is Entering a More Dangerous Phase
desc: Fabricated AI-generated videos of senior Nigerian officials are becoming harder to detect, raising concerns ahead of the 2027 election cycle.

headline: CBN Cuts One-Year Treasury-Bill Rate as Investors Flood Auction With ₦3.63 Trillion in Bids
desc: Nigeria's latest Treasury Bills auction drew ₦3.63 trillion in bids for the one-year bill even as the Central Bank cut the rate offered.

headline: Tinubu Orders National Threat Assessment and Five-Year Defence Strategy
desc: President Bola Tinubu has ordered a comprehensive national threat assessment and a five-year strategic defence plan for Nigeria.

headline: Nigeria's Kidnapping Economy Reaches Alarming Scale Across Multiple Regions
desc: New research reviewed by Stream26 News finds 7,825 people were kidnapped in Nigeria in a single year, with confirmed ransom payments reaching ₦7.78 billion.

headline: NFF Crisis Deepens as Ibrahim Gusau and Executive Committee Resign
desc: Nigeria Football Federation president Ibrahim Gusau, general secretary Mohammed Sanusi, and the executive committee have resigned weeks before the scheduled elective congress.

headline: Niger State Kidnapping: What Is Confirmed — and What Remains Unclear
desc: A mass kidnapping in Niger State has produced conflicting claims about the number of victims. Stream26 News is not treating unverified online figures as confirmed fact.

headline: Why Nigeria's Non-Oil Exports Are Quietly Becoming a Bigger Story Than Oil
desc: An explainer on the growing role of agriculture, services, and manufacturing in Nigeria's export economy alongside its traditional oil sector.

headline: Arsenal Could Unleash New Signings Against Aston Villa
desc: Arsenal could introduce Bruno Guimaraes and Ezri Konsa against Aston Villa, with Konsa potentially facing his former club in his first appearance.

headline: Liverpool Complete Bradley Barcola Deal in £107m-Plus Transfer From PSG
desc: Liverpool have officially completed the signing of Bradley Barcola from PSG for an initial £107 million, rising to around £120-123m with add-ons.

headline: Champions League Draw Delivers PSG-Barcelona Blockbuster and Real Madrid-Arsenal Clash
desc: The 2026/27 UEFA Champions League league-phase draw, completed in Monaco, has produced some of the biggest fixtures European football can offer.

headline: Enzo Fernández Completes £125m Deadline-Day Move to Manchester City
desc: Chelsea's Enzo Fernández has completed a £125 million transfer to Manchester City, matching the British transfer record, leaving Chelsea to find a midfield replacement.

headline: Liverpool Break the British Transfer Record to Sign Alexander Isak
desc: Liverpool have completed a British-record transfer fee to sign Swedish striker Alexander Isak, according to reports.

headline: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off: Matchday 1 in Full Swing
desc: The 2026/27 Premier League season is underway, with Arsenal entering as defending champions and a full Matchday 1 fixture list live today.

headline: Chelsea Make Morgan Rogers the Most Expensive British Footballer Ever
desc: Chelsea have completed a club-record move for Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa, reportedly making him the most expensive British player in history.

headline: UEFA-FIFA Power Struggle Escalates as Infantino Faces Fresh Scrutiny
desc: UEFA is preparing legal action concerning FIFA president Gianni Infantino and the abandoned Forward Enterprise proposal, exposing a deeper fight over football's commercial future.

headline: US and Iran Trade Fresh Strikes as Month-Long Lull in Fighting Collapses
desc: US strikes on IRGC targets near the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian retaliation have ended a month-long lull in a war that has run since February 2026.

headline: Wedding Gathering Hit in Southern Iran Strike, Iranian Officials Say
desc: Iranian officials say a US strike near the Strait of Hormuz hit a house hosting a wedding gathering in Kuhestak, killing four to five people.

headline: Xi Jinping Arrives in Egypt as China Seeks Bigger Role in Middle East Security
desc: Xi Jinping's visit to Cairo comes as renewed US-Iran fighting and Hormuz disruption fuel competition between major powers over Middle East security.

headline: Germany Accuses Russia Over Leipzig Airport Explosive-Drone Plot
desc: German authorities say an explosive-equipped drone was found at Leipzig/Halle Airport and have attributed the plot to Russian-linked activity, which Moscow denies.

headline: AI Data Centres Are Creating a New Problem: Who Pays for the Electricity?
desc: The AI boom's rapid data-centre build-out is straining electricity grids and water supplies worldwide, raising a political question over who bears the infrastructure cost.

headline: US Government Shutdown Fight Pushed Down the Road — Not Resolved
desc: The House has passed temporary funding through December 11, avoiding an immediate US government shutdown without resolving the underlying budget dispute.

headline: Oil Surges as Iran Conflict Threatens the World's Most Important Energy Chokepoint
desc: Brent crude has climbed toward $95 a barrel as renewed US-Iran fighting raises fears of a prolonged disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: Turkey Looks East While Remaining in NATO
desc: President Erdogan has signalled Turkey could deepen ties with the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, testing how far a NATO member can balance East and West.

headline: Uber Ends 12-Year Nigerian Journey — And Its Uganda Operations Too
desc: Uber shut down ride-hailing in Nigeria and Uganda on the same day, ending a 12-year presence in Nigeria amid tough competition and rising costs.

headline: EFCC Dismisses More Than 40 Staff in Internal Corruption Crackdown
desc: EFCC chairman Ola Olukoyede says over 40 personnel have been dismissed for corruption in the past three years, with more than five already facing prosecution.

headline: Uber Cuts 3,300 Jobs as Global Restructuring Adds Another Layer to African Exit
desc: Uber is cutting roughly 3,300 corporate jobs worldwide as it simplifies its organisation while investing heavily in autonomous vehicles.

headline: Shein Shares Slide After Hong Kong Listing as Investors Reassess Fast-Fashion Giant
desc: Shein's Hong Kong debut valued the company at about $26.5 billion, a fraction of its 2022 peak, after shares fell as much as 10% on their first trading day.

headline: Honda Unveils $9.4bn Cost-Cutting Drive as Chinese EV Makers Reshape the Industry
desc: Honda is targeting $9.4 billion in savings by 2030 and demanding 30% price cuts from suppliers as Chinese EV competition intensifies.

headline: Premier League Clubs Spend £3.46bn as English Football Smashes Its Transfer Record Again
desc: Premier League clubs spent roughly £3.46 billion in the 2026 summer window, smashing last summer's record, with Manchester City the biggest spenders.

headline: Manchester City Complete Iliman Ndiaye Deal as Spending Goes Into Overdrive
desc: Manchester City have signed Senegal international Iliman Ndiaye from Everton for £65 million, taking City's summer spending past £450 million.

headline: Everton's Folarin Balogun Deal Collapses at the Final Hour
desc: Everton's proposed £40 million move for Monaco striker Folarin Balogun collapsed on deadline day after medical concerns emerged during negotiations.

headline: Chelsea Lose Lamine Camara Deal After Monaco Pulls the Plug
desc: Chelsea's attempt to sign Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara as a replacement for Enzo Fernández collapsed after Monaco withdrew from the deal.

headline: Champions League Returns With Real Madrid-Inter, Liverpool-Atlético and Napoli-Arsenal
desc: The 2026/27 Champions League league phase opens with Real Madrid vs Inter and Porto vs Man City on September 8, then Liverpool-Atlético and Napoli-Arsenal on September 9.

headline: Super Eagles Face AFCON 2027 Qualifiers as Nigerian Football Attempts to Reset
desc: Nigeria's Super Eagles begin AFCON 2027 qualification against Madagascar and Guinea-Bissau as the Nigeria Football Federation undergoes a leadership transition.
